out_of_scope.reason: Cones of other lengths (Cone of Cold 60 ft, Color Spray, dragon breath and so on) belong to spells and monsters the engine doesn't have. Burning Hands' 15 ft is the only Cone length in scope.

A.summary: GLOSS.cone defines the Cone area of effect. It extends in straight lines from a point of origin in a direction the creator chooses. Its width at any point equals that point's distance from the origin (15 ft wide at 15 ft). The creating effect sets its maximum length, and the origin point is left out
